subject: Renewal addendum, capacity ramp & SLA credit request
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.inference.com>
To: Karen Liu <karen@habitatlabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Q1 usage & renewal prep — Habitat Labs

Hi Karen —

Attached is a short Q1 usage and performance pack (Q1_inference_report.pdf) summarizing token spend, latency percentiles, and a few ops notes we saw in March. High-level points:

- Usage: steady growth, ~32% quarter-over-quarter token increase driven by a new feature (session-based summarization).
- Cost/efficiency: average tokens per call up 12% (prompt length increase); recommend enabling prefix caching on the embedding route to recover some of that.
- Performance: we saw two short latency spikes on 2027-03-18 (95th p99) due to a background rollout; we documented timeline and rollback steps in the appendix.

With your renewal coming up in May, wanted to surface capacity options that balance runway and unit economics: 1) 12-month extension with 20% token commit uplift and staged ramp, 2) 9-month add-on ramp for a limited window, or 3) usage-based overage protection credits + monthly variable billing.

Could we schedule a 30-minute check next week to walk the pack and agree on a path? I’m free Wed/Thu afternoons PDT.

Thanks,
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
(s: 415-555-0136)

Attachments: Q1_inference_report.pdf (report, 8 pages)

From: Karen Liu <karen@habitatlabs.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 31 Mar 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q1 usage & renewal prep — Habitat Labs

Sofia —

Thanks for the report and the clear options. Quick questions before we book time:

1) The latency spikes you called out impacted our real-time labeling flow for ~45 minutes on 2027-03-18. We saw elevated p95/p99 across several routes. Our engineering lead is asking whether a service credit is on the table for that incident.
2) For the staged ramp option: can we front-load some capacity earlier? We have a marketing launch planned mid-June and want headroom to avoid throttling.

I'll loop in procurement in a sec. Happy to meet Thurs at 1pm PDT if that works for you and Ben.

—Karen
Karen Liu
Head of ML Platform, Habitat Labs

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.inference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 31 Mar 2027 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Re: Q1 usage & renewal prep — Habitat Labs

Ben / Mina —

FYI: Karen flagged the March 18 latency spike and asked about service credit. Also asked whether we can move some capacity earlier to cover a mid-June launch. Meeting Thurs 1pm PDT — please join.

My thinking: offer a 12-month addendum with a 20% committed token uplift, but allow a front-loaded ramp to provide 30% of uplift in May/June, followed by the remainder across months 3–12. Provide a one-time 10% invoice credit tied to the documented March 18 incident (transparent, limited). Ben — can you draft an addendum (simple terms)? Mina — please prepare a short ops note on what we will do to prevent recurrence and what monitoring we’ll share.

Sofia

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference.com>
To: Karen Liu <karen@habitatlabs.com>
Cc: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.inference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Apr 2027 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed addendum: ramp schedule + incident credit (Habitat Labs)

Karen —

Thanks for the quick reply and for raising the latency impact. We ran the incident log with Eng and agree the March 18 rollout contributed. To keep things simple for renewal, we propose the following:

- Term: 12-month addendum starting 2027-05-01 attached as proposed-addendum-2027.docx
- Commit uplift: +20% annual token commit (baseline remains current committed volume)
- Front-load: 30% of the uplift will be available immediately on 2027-05-01 to cover the mid-June launch; remaining 70% ramps monthly across months 3–12.
- Incident credit: one-time 10% credit applied to the June 2027 invoice in recognition of the March 18 disruption.
- SLA language: we can commit to refined p95/p99 targets in the addendum and include a short appendix on rollback processes; exceptions for planned maintenance will be called out.

If that sounds workable I’ll send the DocuSign envelope tonight and we can begin the process once signed. Attached: proposed-addendum-2027.docx (word, 4 pages).

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager — Redwood Inference

Attachments: proposed-addendum-2027.docx

From: Karen Liu <karen@habitatlabs.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: procurement@habitatlabs.com, Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.inference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed addendum: ramp schedule + incident credit (Habitat Labs)

Ben / team —

Appreciate the clear proposal. A few notes from procurement/ops:

- We can accept a 12-month term but would prefer the ramp window be shortened to 9 months for cash-flow planning. Can you support changing the ramp to 30% front-load + 70% across months 2–9?
- Please clarify SLA appendix language around p99: we need a measurable target and the exact remedy (credit schedule) for repeat incidents.
- We will sign once legal confirms the addendum language; please send via DocuSign and include a short statement that the one-time credit is non-precedential.

If you can update the ramp schedule to 9 months and send the DocuSign link, we can aim to sign by Apr 8.

Thanks,
Karen
Karen Liu
Head of ML Platform, Habitat Labs

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.inference.com>
To: Karen Liu <karen@habitatlabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.inference.com>, procurement@habitatlabs.com
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed addendum: ramp schedule + incident credit (Habitat Labs)

Karen —

Thanks — we can accommodate the 9-month ramp (30% upfront on May 1, remaining 70% spread across months 2–9). Ben has updated the addendum to reflect the revised ramp and more specific p99 language (see DocuSign link below). The one-time credit is explicitly marked non-precedential in the addendum.

Next steps:
- Ben: send DocuSign envelope tonight (Ben -> done)
- Habitat legal/procurement: sign by Apr 8 if possible
- Mina / Ops: once signed we’ll schedule the onboarding call for May 3 to confirm front-loaded capacity and monitoring dashboards; Mina, please circulate the ops runbook (ops-runbook.xlsx).
- I’ll update the HubSpot deal record: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/681234/HAB-2027-42

Thanks everyone — looking forward to getting the launch covered.

Best,
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

Related links: https://www.docusign.com/sign/EXAMPLE-DocuSignLink
Attachments: ops-runbook.xlsx (spreadsheet, 2 sheets)
